tasks.title: Method resolution order
tasks.statement: Write mro_names(cls): a list of class names in method resolution order (without object). Use cls.__mro__.
tasks.hint: [c.__name__ for c in cls.__mro__ if c is not object].

tasks.title: A cooperative chain in a diamond
tasks.statement: Class A is already written (it prints «A» and calls nothing further). Write B(A), C(A) and D(B, C): the hello() method of each prints its own name and calls super().hello(), so that D().hello() runs each class exactly once in the order D, B, C, A.
tasks.hint: In each hello: print("X"); super().hello(). The diamond will be walked in the MRO D, B, C, A.

tasks.title: Can the bases be combined
tasks.statement: Write can_combine(*bases): True if a class with these bases (in this order) can be created, and False if Python cannot build a consistent MRO (TypeError).
tasks.hint: try: type("X", bases, {}) except TypeError: return False; return True.

tasks.title: Cooperative __init__
tasks.statement: Write NameMixin and AgeMixin: each takes its own keyword parameter (name or age), stores it and passes the remaining parameters on via super().__init__(**kwargs). The Base class already absorbs the remaining parameters into the extra field. The order of the bases in Person must not affect the result.

tasks.title: The ReprMixin mixin
tasks.statement: Write a ReprMixin mixin: __repr__ returns the class name and "field=value" pairs of the instance attributes in creation order (Point(x=1, y=2)). It must work in combination with any class that has no __init__ of its own.

tasks.title: The JsonMixin mixin
tasks.statement: Write JsonMixin with a to_json() method: a JSON string of the instance attributes with sorted keys (json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)) and a class method from_json(text) that creates an object without calling __init__ and writes the fields from the JSON into it.
tasks.hint: from_json: obj = cls.__new__(cls); obj.__dict__.update(json.loads(text)); return obj.

tasks.title: A wrapper mixin via super
tasks.statement: The Model class already has save() (it returns "saved"). Write LoggingMixin: its save() appends the string "before save" to the LOG list, calls super().save(), appends "after save" and returns the result. The mixin must be placed to the left of Model.
tasks.hint: class LoggingMixin: def save(self): LOG.append(...); result = super().save(); LOG.append(...); return result.

tasks.title: Where a method is defined
tasks.statement: Write where_defined(cls, name): the name of the first class in the MRO that has the name `name` in its own __dict__, or None if there is none. Also write chain(cls, name): a list of the names of all classes in the MRO that define this name (in MRO order).
tasks.hint: for c in cls.__mro__: if name in vars(c): ...

tasks.title: Checks on mixins
tasks.statement: The base Validator.validate(value) returns an empty list. Write NotEmpty (the error "empty" for an empty string) and NoDigits (the error "digits" if the string contains a digit): each calls super().validate(value) and adds its own error. The classes can be combined in any way.
tasks.hint: errors = super().validate(value); if not value: errors = errors + ["empty"]; return errors.
